name: RapYourPhoto
tagline: Turn 1-2 photos into a short AI rap music video.
description: RapYourPhoto is an AI rap video generator. Pick a scene, add one photo to rap solo or two for a duet, and get a 10 or 15 second video with AI vocals and a beat, in portrait or landscape up to 1080p. Great for birthday shout-outs, roasts and TikTok or Reels.
